header.title: Selected statistics for all companies in the industry group of architectural, surveying and engineering services
tablenote: The above statistics are compiled based on the Hong Kong Standard Industrial Classification (HSIC) Version 2.0.  Users may also download past statistics based on HSIC Version 1.1 for reference.
Figures for 2020 to 2022 include the amount of subsidy related to anti-epidemic measures.
header.source: Annual Survey of Economic Activities Construction & Miscellaneous Services Statistics Section, Census and Statistics Department (Enquiry telephone no. : 3903 6964  Enquiry e-mail : building@censtatd.gov.hk)
